scope: Read-only cross-owner consumer review, pre-fix candidate slices and controlled source changes

findings.trigger: Book full-record footer from a specified invoice ticket inside RelayPanel
findings.evidence: onFullRecord={(next,_record,preparation)=>choose(next,preparation)} drops recordKey. App.selectRelayRecord clears relayRecordId; RelayPanel key includes initialFocusId, so remount loses specified invoice reading and returns to meter/default entry.
findings.required: Carry original recordKey/initialFocusId to owned parent state or explicitly retain the same ticket; do not silently substitute another ticket. Draft memory must stay canonical.

findings.trigger: Revisit a meter whose independent audit job is already planned/running and auditedUnits is still null
findings.evidence: Book audits only checks auditedUnits===null to offer another audit; meter row has no active audit wait. SceneProgress meter branch and Purpose unknown-meter text do not bind existing active audit. Core rejects duplicate work, but next action/waiting object is wrong.
findings.required: Resolve unique original active audit/batch/job; show its actual committed start/complete date and original wait/read action. Only no-active meters may start new audit. Unknown actual units remain unknown.

findings.trigger: Confirm a fully specified RenewRelayCustomer response
findings.evidence: Editor passes termEnd/mode/creditLimitFen with confirm:true, but final captured confirmation has no Renew-specific details. Generic account/zero-fee text omits these actual new contract conditions.
findings.required: Publish same original customer/old conditions and exact selected new end/payment mode/credit in the original confirmation; preserve old prepayments/receivables and original core preview.

findings.trigger: Confirm StartRelayRequote with explicit selected customers and offerKind
findings.evidence: Existing confirmation lists only customer count/unit price/effectiveAt, omitting selected customer identities and charging mode/service-fee commitment. These are materially different contract choices.
findings.required: Show original customer ordinals/contracts, exact offer kind/support baseline, selected resources/start/effective date in captured original confirmation; no new rule or payload changes.

findings.trigger: A retained original RelayJob advance handler after controller publishes a newer saved view
findings.evidence: RelayJob direct props.request(AdvanceTime,job.completeAt) uses locked(old flags/controller.busy), not click-time same-view guard. App.request prepares from latest snapshot, accepting an old UI date intent if original preview permits. Core money/barriers remain enforced, but old snapshot activation contract is bypassed.
findings.required: Use the same makeSharedAction/original ClockAdvance source-view binding before requesting the unchanged original date/fee review.
